advice.title: Recommended actions
advice.note: Rule-based on severity — requires human confirmation
high: Dispatch officers to the scene immediately
Implement on-site traffic control if needed
medium: Dispatch officers to verify on site
Reroute traffic to prevent secondary crashes
Notify medical services if injuries are suspected
low: Log and file into the incident ledger
Pull nearby camera footage to review the event
Notify involved parties to handle it directly

credibility.title: Model credibility
credibility.none: No human review recorded yet — metrics cannot be computed
credibility.noneHint: "Not reviewed yet" and "0% accuracy" are different things, so no number is shown here. Review any incident on its detail page and this panel fills in.
credibility.precisionHint: share of reported incidents that really happened
credibility.severityAccuracyHint: share of real incidents graded correctly
credibility.recallPending: Sampling labels incomplete — recall cannot be computed
credibility.blindSpot: These metrics exclude missed detections. They describe how many of the reported incidents were real; accidents that happened but were never reported would need a separate negative-sample label set.

labeling.subtitle: Sampled {{total}} of {{frames}} frames. Judging them one by one is the only way to compute recall.

system.title: System Status
system.liveUnavailable: Start the local inference service first
system.modeStaticHint: Reads pre-computed results — instant, no services needed. This is the roadshow fallback.
system.modeLiveHint: Showing real inference results produced on this machine; frames and video come from the latest live run.
system.backendDown: The local inference backend is not running. It schedules YOLO detection and multimodal understanding — start it first:
system.janusDown: Not connected (run ./scripts/janus_up.sh to start it and open the tunnel)
system.searchEncoderDown: Encoder unreachable (tunnel or remote not up)
system.alertNotConfigured: Not configured (no alerts will be sent)
system.alertRule: {{sev}} and above · up to {{max}} per run
system.alertHowTo2: at the project root with a target URL (a DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom group bot, or SMTP), then reload this page.
system.alertOnRunHint: Events at or above the threshold are pushed the moment they are graded. Sent items show up in the run list below.
system.alertNeedWebhook: No alert channel configured, so pushing is unavailable. Analysis still runs normally.
system.alertTestSent: Sent — check the group or mailbox
system.liveAnalyzeHint: Re-runs the full pipeline on the source video (detect → cluster → AI reading). Roughly {{min}} minutes — about 90% of it is frame-by-frame CPU detection. It runs in the background, so you can keep presenting on other pages.
system.needJanus: Multimodal service unavailable; live analysis is disabled
system.recentRunsHint: Load a completed run to replace the current data with its real results — no need to wait another 6 minutes just to show it. Interrupted runs have no artifacts and can only be deleted.
system.runsKeepHint: Oldest artifacts are pruned automatically above {{gb}} GB; the newest {{keep}} are always kept, and running jobs are never touched.
system.deleteHint: Removes all artifacts of this run. Not recoverable.
system.resetHint: Clear all handling states and trails, back to initial
